BUILD CONFIDENCE, ONE SKILL AT A TIME

Real interview skills.
Hands-on practice.

Rotate between four core SQA disciplines with structured questions and interactive scenarios.

01 / MANUALThink like a tester

Risk-based test design, exploratory testing, bug reports, and release decisions.

02 / APITest the contract

HTTP behavior, auth, validation, status codes, and negative cases in a mock API console.

03 / AUTOMATIONWrite reliable tests

Practice Playwright, Cypress, and Selenium patterns with editable scripts and clear rubrics.

04 / MOBILETest beyond the screen

Explore device sizes, offline recovery, permissions, and app lifecycle scenarios.

Challenge checklist
Your solution

Draft a script, then run it locally with your selected framework. The hub stores and reviews your submission; it does not execute arbitrary code.

Review guide100 points
Coverage30Happy path, negatives, edges
Assertions25Prove visible outcomes
Reliability25Stable locators and waits
Approach20Clear reasoning and trade-offs
Start by mapping a valid login, an invalid password, and a direct visit to the protected page after logout. Assert visible results rather than only checking a URL.
A strong solution checks the primary journey, negative inputs, session boundaries, and recovery. Use user-facing locators, wait for a meaningful state, and explain any test data or coverage limits.
